messages:
leo: Heads up — customers are seeing tokens deducted twice in the console after SDK retries. Sample: https://internal/issue/123
sara: which SDK? node or python?
leo: node client 2.1.0. It retries on 429 and logs quota deduction events to the console via clientlib. They surface as two meter events: one from initial req, one from retry.
anna: can you paste logs?
leo: 
leo: ```
[client] request id=abc123 retry=0 tokens=250
[client] retrying request id=abc123 retry=1 cause=429
[metering] emit event: {route: "text-gen", tokens:250, origin:"sdk"}
[metering] emit event: {route: "text-gen", tokens:250, origin:"sdk-retry"}
```
raj: ah — SDK emits meter events pre-retry and post-retry. we should not emit before success. that's our fault
sara: was this changed in 2.1.0? I remember a telemetry PR for early sampling
leo: yes PR #789 added early telemetry for latency analysis
dave: idea: add an idempotency key to metering events, so pipeline dedupes by (client_id, idempotency_key)
sara: metering pipeline already has fingerprint dedupe but it's not idempotency-key aware
anna: adding idempotency will need clientlib + ingestion schema change — rollout implications for older sdk
raj: could do a conservative rollout: start with SDK writing a flag event "metering.schema: idempotency_v1" then server can opt-in
leo: UX issue: invoices show preview as double, customers email support. Console should highlight "pending retries" or hide SDK-origin events
dave: agree — quick fix: mark SDK-origin events with tag `sdk_preview:true` and have invoice preview ignore those for now
sara: ops: will that break any internal dashboards? some dashboards rely on raw ingest counts
anna: we can add a transform in preview pipeline only (not ledger) to filter sdk_preview
leo: timeline: if we push SDK change next week + ingestion transform, Q/A for 2 days, then feature flag in console, we can stop customer-facing duplicates in 2 weeks
metering-bot: deploy pipeline note: has 3 failing tests in ingest-transform branch
raj: thanks bot. action items: leo file issue to SDK repo, anna update ingest schema proposal, dave mock console change, sara coordinate with support to reply templates
leo: done — https://github.com/redwood/sdk/issues/1010
sara: assigned to me to draft support reply
anna: I'll open PR for transform and add unit tests
dave: will prototype console patch by EOD
leo: :thumbsup:
